newsitem.title: USA: Flagstar's Denny's taps new ad agency.
newsitem.headline: Flagstar's Denny's taps new ad agency.

text.p: Flagstar Cos Inc's Denny's Monday said it selected New York-based Chisholm-Mingo Group Inc as its new African-American advertising agency of record.

The Chisholm-Mingo Group will handle Denny's black consumer marketing efforts. Their marketing and advertising responsibilities for Denny's will include the creation and placement of television, print, radio and outdoor advertising as well as development of local marketing and community relations programs and events. The first advertising campaign for Denny's created by The Chisholm-Mingo Group is expected to be introduced by the end of February.
The Chisholm-Mingo Group replaces Glover Communications, formerly Glover & Potter Advertising, which has served as Denny's African-American agency of record since December 1993.
In 1993, some employees of Denny's restaurants were accused of discriminating against blacks.

Denny's is the nation's largest full-service family restaurant chain with about 1,600 restaurants throughout the United States, two U.S. territories and five foreign countries. Denny's had 1995 annual revenues of $1.49 billion.
